verdict.rationale: All documented Mem0 capabilities center on storing conversational facts/messages and retrieving them via semantic search (mem0-docs-6, mem0-docs-26, mem0-docs-35); nothing in the evidence pack mentions ingesting images, PDFs, or other file types as memory inputs. This is a fair capability to ask of a memory-layer product, so absence of evidence yields 'none' rather than 'na'.
